svg.title: One loop, five hundred round trips
svg.desc: Blank version of the sketch “One loop, five hundred round trips” with all labels removed, for drawing from memory. A Python loop firing eight drawn arrows and an implied five hundred separate SELECTs at a database, crossed out in red, at 501 queries and 1321.5 milliseconds; beside it the same loop with selectinload issuing two fat arrows at 61.6 milliseconds. Below, the SQLAlchemy Session is drawn as an identity map plus a pending-changes list, flushed in order at commit, with bars comparing ORM add_all at 5448 ms against COPY at 518 ms for 100 000 rows.
svg.text: One loop, five hundred round trips
draw it from memory, then compare
